title: Extension Charge Pricing Worksheet — Builder Extended Rate Lock
content:
**Clause.** The increments priced are the extension days used on the Builder Extended Rate Lock less the extension days already carried by extension fee charges on the lock ledger, divided by the term's increment days. The extension fee percent is the term's extension fee percent per increment. The per-increment extension fee is the extension fee percent of the loan amount on the lock, rounded half up to the cent, with a floor of the term's minimum extension fee. The extension charge is the per-increment extension fee for the first increment priced — where the term's first increment carries no fee and no increment had been written on the lock before it, that first increment is charged at zero — and the per-increment extension fee for each further increment priced, the total rounded half up to the cent.

## Quantities and records

| Quantity | Read from |
|---|---|
| Extension days used | the lock record |
| Extension days already charged | the extension days carried by the extension fee charges on the lock ledger |
| Increment days, extension fee percent, minimum extension fee, whether the first increment carries no fee | the product's extension figures for the lock's term |
| Loan amount | the lock record |
| Increments written before the extension | the extensions used on the lock record less the increments priced |

Where no increment is priced, there is no extension charge.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs: 15-day increments, fee percent 0.125, minimum USD 250.00)

Loan amount USD 412345.00: 0.125 percent is 515.43125, rounded half up to the cent USD 515.43, above the minimum; per-increment fee USD 515.43.

| Extension days used | Already charged | Increments priced | Increments written before | First increment carries no fee on the term | Extension charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30 | 0 | 2 | 0 | No | 515.43 and 515.43, total USD 1030.86 |
| 30 | 0 | 2 | 0 | Yes | 0.00 and 515.43, total USD 515.43 |
| 30 | 15 | 1 | 1 | Yes | USD 515.43 — an increment had been written before |

Loan amount USD 150000.00: 0.125 percent is 187.50, below the minimum, so the per-increment fee is USD 250.00.
